motive.canonical: Priya forged Isabella's signature on the partnership transfer documents and killed Isabella to prevent her exposing the forgery to the solicitor.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the brass letter opener on Isabella's desk, in the bookshop back room.

opportunity.canonical: Priya was alone in the bookshop with Isabella during the murder window. The invoice gap and green thread prove she left the stockroom and entered the back room.

explanation: Correct. Priya Shah killed Isabella Reed. Priya had forged Isabella's signature on the bookshop partnership transfer after Marcus Bell named her his successor — she didn't trust Isabella to agree. When the solicitor's letter arrived at 11:10 confirming Isabella had discovered the forgery and booked a 13:30 appointment, Priya read it first and understood her window was closing. She confronted Isabella in the back room at 12:35; when Isabella reached for the telephone, Priya seized the Victorian letter opener and struck her. She staged a break-in by smashing the window pane from inside — but the glass fell the wrong way. Her scarf snagged on the rear latch as she fled through the alley. The invoice timestamp proves she was not in the stockroom during the murder window.
